sources.label: Morphe patches for Pdb (pdb.app): premium unlock, ad removal, PairIP bypass and
sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Disables Adobe's extension-discovery service and messaging activities and sets the Firebase Analytics collection opt-outs.
Disables Adobe (Omniture) analytics by stopping the Adobe Experience Platform extension registration, so no tracking payload is built or sent.
Turns on Nike Run Club's built-in dark theme by forcing the DefaultDesignManager colour-mode gate, so the Compose UI renders dark.
Nike Run Club ships no ad SDK or placement; this disables any ad-SDK auto-init provider and removes the advertising-ID / ad-services / referrer permissions so no advertising ID is exposed.
